summary: PR-4 (Executive Summary + Attack Story lenses) backend-only validation. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_pr4_api_endpoints.py (14 API-level integration tests) covering enriched summary/story shape, determinism, auth, owner-scoping, workspace state persistence, workspace bundle aggregation, and regression (list_cases + state transition). All 14 API tests pass against the public preview URL (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Also re-ran the L2 unit suite: 87/87 pass (test_pr4_summary_and_story = 16 [not 17 as request claimed], plus contracts/determinism/state_machine/workspace_state).

minor.issue: Cloudflare 502 / ReadTimeout observed intermittently during initial run — same infra flake noted in the review request. Retry succeeds; not a PR-4 code issue.

critical_code_review_comments: workspace_investigation.py routers/_service_endpoint uses `out.to_dict() | {"fingerprint": ...}` which will silently overwrite a body-level 'fingerprint' key if a future L2 service ever emits one. Non-blocking but worth guarding.

Owner-scoping test had to seed a second user directly into MongoDB because there is NO public /api/auth/register endpoint and no /api/admin/users create endpoint. Consider adding an admin-only user create endpoint to make multi-user auth flows testable end-to-end without direct DB writes.

/app/backend/conftest.py forces DB_NAME=nivxray_ci_local for pytest, which does NOT match the running backend's DB_NAME (test_database from .env). Any integration test that seeds Mongo via env vars will hit the wrong DB. My test explicitly parses /app/backend/.env to work around this — worth documenting or reconciling.
PR-4 unit-test count in the review request says '17 tests' but the file test_pr4_summary_and_story.py has 16 tests. Cosmetic doc drift.
seed_data_creation: Each test-run creates a case with case_id=TEST-PR4-<uuid8> via POST /api/investigation using the synthetic bundle (mirror of tests/l2_investigation/_fixtures.synthetic_bundle). Case is DELETE'd in fixture teardown. Owner-scoping test also seeds+deletes a temporary user (TEST_pr4-<hex>@example.com) directly in Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_pr4_api_endpoints.py can be re-run any time: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_pr4_api_endpoints.py -v -o addopts=`. It defaults to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (public preview); override with PR4_TEST_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8001 if the preview URL is flaky. Owner-scoping test seeds directly into MongoDB using values from /app/backend/.env (NOT env vars, because conftest.py overrides DB_NAME during pytest). All 14 PR-4 API tests + 87 L2 unit tests currently pass.
verified_endpoints: GET  /api/investigation/{case_id}/story (version=0.2.0-pr4, 4 events with event_id/iteration/pass_name/chapter/transformation/text/anchor{kind=transformation}, chapters ordered Unwrap→Normalize→Decode→Interpret with event_count≥1, non-empty deterministic narrative mentioning cobalt_strike)
PUT  /api/investigation/{case_id}/workspace (selected_evidence_id, mode, active_lens, filters — all persist and echo back)
